rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken construction for doing something perfectly or without flaws.

example.english: They wrote the report impeccably, without a single typo.
example.traditional: 佢份報告寫得完美，連一個錯字都冇。
example.jyutping: keoi5 fan6 bou3 gou3 se2 dak1 jyun4 mei5 lin4 jat1 go3 co3 zi6 dou1 mou5
